instructionSummary:
create a tool which will take topics and try to find related research papers, blogs and analyse those. here it will use OpenAI to get the information and then go through those research topics. create a graphical nodal analysis to understand the corelation. Then from important nodes to explore moer. And eventually it should give a robust understanding of the query topic and suggest how to implement and refer github repos. On request it will explore those codebase and try to create solution if requires. If it is for ideation then drafting of idea/patent/whitepapers it will do. This tool should give highest optimal, efficient solution only rather than giving all options.

Branding colours: SaaS Momentum (#293681, #4274D9, #95CCD0, #DDE7E6). Recommended for ai. Use these as brand direction while maintaining accessible text/background contrast.
